evals.prompt: connect to my Tarvis workspace at https://war.tarvis.site
evals.expected_output: The private workspace origin derived, VPN and Tailscale setup confirmed, health checked, browser pairing completed, and MCP configured at user scope.
expectations: Derives https://war.ts.tarvis.site from the supplied workspace URL
Guides the user to enable workspace VPN and accept the Tailscale invitation before probing
Requires the private /health endpoint to succeed before pairing
Sends client_name on /api/agent/auth/request
Opens or displays the private .ts approval URL instead of requesting credentials
Writes the server at user scope and verifies with tools/list
Tells the user to fully quit and reopen the client

evals.prompt: I installed the Tarvis plugin but there are no tools yet. My workspace is https://oak.tarvis.site
evals.expected_output: Recognized as an unpaired client and taken through Tailscale-backed workspace pairing.
expectations: Does not treat missing MCP tools as a plugin installation fault
Uses https://oak.ts.tarvis.site rather than local-network discovery
Checks VPN, Tailscale, and health before requesting access
Ends with a configured MCP server and restart instruction

evals.prompt: Every Tarvis tool says unauthorized now; reconnect my https://war.tarvis.site workspace
evals.expected_output: The revoked or expired token replaced through a fresh browser-approved pairing request.
expectations: Identifies the existing token as revoked or expired
Requests a fresh grant instead of reusing the old request id
Replaces the configured server rather than adding a duplicate
Keeps login credentials in the browser and never asks for them in chat

evals.prompt: Pair my workspace; open the authorization page for me
evals.expected_output: The user is asked for the workspace URL, guided through Tailscale, and sent to the generated private approval page before code exchange.
expectations: Asks for the base workspace URL before deriving its .ts origin
Rewrites approve_url onto the .ts workspace origin while preserving its path and query
Attempts to open the URL locally and also leaves it visible for manual opening
Keeps the request id from the saved response
Exchanges the code promptly without printing the token
